name: Atlassian Rovo
description: Atlassian’s Rovo MCP Server enables secure, permission-aware access to Jira and Confluence from external AI tools like Claude. It supports summarization, creation, and multi-step actions, helping teams tap into structured enterprise knowledge wherever they work—all while preserving data privacy and leveraging Atlassian’s open, interoperable Teamwork Graph foundation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Atlassian Rovo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Atlassian Rovo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Atlassian Rovo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Atlassian Rovo lists 31 MCP tools, including atlassianUserInfo, getAccessibleAtlassianResources, getConfluenceSpaces, getConfluencePage, getPagesInConfluenceSpace, getConfluencePageAncestors, getConfluencePageFooterComments, getConfluencePageInlineComments, getConfluencePageDescendants, createConfluencePage, updateConfluencePage, and createConfluenceFooterComment.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Atlassian Rovo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Atlassian Rovo in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Atlassian Rovo MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Atlassian Rovo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Atlassian Rovo is developed by Atlassian. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
